name: World connectivity map
notes: The map every level bead builds from (mw-e24.1, docs/design/world-map.md): places, the ways between them, ability gates and the loops of story bible 3.1. Nodes with a scene are built; edges with transitions are built; every planned edge names the bead that builds it. Time gates read the game clock phases (mw-e27.12).

nodes.name: The slice vestibule
nodes.notes: The m1 slice scene's vestibule; a passage leads out onto the mountain road (mw-e24.21).

nodes.name: The mountain road
nodes.notes: Where the player arrives at dusk (bible 4.1 beat 1); the road runs down to the town.

nodes.name: The valley road (middle)
nodes.notes: Middle stretch of the road down the steep green valley (bible 3.1).

nodes.name: The valley road (river end)
nodes.notes: Last stretch before the Miners' Bridge; the River Wend runs beside it.

nodes.name: The Bridge Watch post
nodes.notes: Town end of the Miners' Bridge (bible 3.5); the town spawn: everything from the valley passes it first.

nodes.name: The shop lane
nodes.notes: The lane past the post: Marsh's, the Sleeping Ox, the Bridgeward College (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: Marsh's General Store
nodes.notes: First building past the bridge (bible 3.5, 5.15).

nodes.name: The Sleeping Ox
nodes.notes: Dot's inn, its front door on the shop lane (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The Bridgeward College
nodes.notes: Soldierly college at the far end of the lane's west side (bible 3.5, 5.16).

nodes.name: Under the Miners' Bridge
nodes.notes: Riverbank where Idris Quillon waits after dark (bible 3.5, 5.17); lit path down from the lane.

nodes.name: Market Green
nodes.notes: The town's heart with the notice board (bible 3.5): the open square of the briar-glen-green scene (mw-e24.2), reached from the shop lane's north end by the green-gate and lane-gate transitions.

nodes.name: The Lamplit Stacks
nodes.notes: Mirela's bookshop (bible 3.5, 5.1). Three storeys leaning west onto the forge yard (mw-e24.2 greybox).

nodes.name: Brand's Forge
nodes.notes: Oswin Brand's smithy (bible 3.5, 5.7).

nodes.name: Fenn's Fletchery & Simples
nodes.notes: Juniper Fenn's shop (bible 3.5, 5.6).

nodes.name: Pell's Bakery
nodes.notes: Hollis Pell's bakery (bible 3.5, 5.5).

nodes.name: The Watch House
nodes.notes: Captain Hale's post with its one-cell jail (bible 3.5, 5.2).

nodes.name: The jail cell
nodes.notes: The one cell, with a drain that leads out (mw-e24.8).

nodes.name: Vane House
nodes.notes: The mine owner's house on the rise (bible 3.5, 5.3). A 40 m tower on a 4 m rise: visible from everywhere in town (mw-e24.2).

nodes.name: The schoolhouse
nodes.notes: Empty; its teacher is missing (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The lychgate cemetery
nodes.notes: Vesperine graves (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The Glen Well
nodes.notes: A loose ladder-rung leads to the old cistern (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The town rooftops
nodes.notes: Roof routes for thieves and climbers (mw-e24.12).

nodes.name: The Briarwood edge (town side)
nodes.notes: Where the town's upper lane meets the forest (bible 3.1: above the town). Built as the south end of the briarwood scene: the town gate (mw-e25.1, mw-e25.22).

nodes.name: The Briarwood paths and clearings
nodes.notes: The forest hub joining the watchtower, priory road and far bank (bible 3.1, mw-e25.1). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The Sleepers' Path
nodes.notes: Line of trampled ferns, visible at night or to a sharp eye (bible 3.5, mw-e25.2). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The Standing Horn
nodes.notes: Hornfolk menhir, hands over its ears (bible 3.5, mw-e25.3). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The wolf den
nodes.notes: Encounter site (bible 3.5, mw-e25.4). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The woodcutter's empty hut
nodes.notes: Bible 3.5. Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The millpond and drowned lane
nodes.notes: Bible 3.5, mw-e25.5. Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The priory road
nodes.notes: Road through the forest to Bellwater Priory (bible 3.5). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: The Briarwood far bank
nodes.notes: Far bank of the Wend, reached over the Millweir sluice walk (bible 3.1). Built as a named marker spawn of the briarwood scene (greybox mw-e25.1); the content on it is a later bead.

nodes.name: Mooring's Watch courtyard
nodes.notes: Goblin lookout below (bible 3.5, mw-e25.6). Built as the spur trail, the lookout camp and the walled courtyard of the moorings-watch scene; the way in from the Briarwood is its spur gate (mw-e25.6, mw-e25.25).

nodes.name: Mooring's Watch tower and roof
nodes.notes: Hollow Sentinels above; keeper's log; signal mirror on the roof (bible 3.5). Built inside the moorings-watch scene (mw-e25.6): four floors, an interior stair and two exterior climbs to the roof; the Sentinels and the mirror puzzle are later beads.

nodes.name: The supply tunnel (watchtower end)
nodes.notes: Old supply tunnel up to the collapse (bible 3.5; mine side is E26). Built as the cellar door (supply-tunnel-door, locked, tunnel-collapsed) over a sealed vestibule in the courtyard's north wall (mw-e25.6); the tunnel beyond is mw-e26 and the way through it mw-e25.9.

nodes.name: The mine road
nodes.notes: The road from Briar Glen's Market Green to the boarded mine gate (bible 3.5). Planned: the town side is a signposted gate stub in briar-glen-green (exit-mine-road, mw-e24.2); the road itself is mw-e25.23. Built (mw-e26.2) as the road strip at the south end of the deepworks scene, entered from the green by the mine-road-gate transition.

nodes.name: The boarded mine gate
nodes.notes: Boarded main gate with the Bell Line rule carved above (bible 3.5, mw-e25.10); E25 owns the exterior. Built (mw-e26.2) as the forecourt and gate wall of the deepworks scene, with the four ways in from outside; the gate puzzle that sets deepworks.gate-open is mw-e25.10.

nodes.name: The winch house
nodes.notes: First interior space inside the gate (bible 3.5, mw-e26.2). Built (mw-e26.2): the first hall inside the gate wall, with the winch lever and the cage lift gate.

nodes.name: The old glenstone galleries
nodes.notes: Square pillared halls; the upper mine (bible 3.5). Built (mw-e26.2): pillared halls with half-cut blocks, mine-cart rails and the supply tunnel collapse in the west wall.

nodes.name: The Rootcellar camp (cutting hall)
nodes.notes: Goblin camp in the old cutting hall (bible 3.5, 5.10); top of the Stone Stair. Built (mw-e26.2): the cutting hall with camp markers and the Stone Stair head; the goblins are mw-e26.3.

nodes.name: The silver galleries
nodes.notes: Newer workings following the silver (bible 3.5). Built (mw-e26.2): narrow galleries one level down, reached by the stair from the cutting hall or by the cage lift.

nodes.name: Vane's sealed gallery
nodes.notes: Ledger, horn-ring and the breach (bible 3.5, 4.1 beat 6). Built (mw-e26.2) as a bare hall with ledger and horn-ring markers; the content is mw-e26.4.

nodes.name: The breach
nodes.notes: Where the mine opened into the Knot (bible 3.5, mw-e26.4). Built (mw-e26.2) as a rubble room ending at the breach-threshold marker; the Outer Ring beyond is mw-e26.9.

nodes.name: The lower Deepworks
nodes.notes: Flooded lower galleries the Weeping Adit enters (bible 3.1). Built (mw-e26.2): the flooded lower gallery with the channel marked for the Frozen Channel (mw-e26.15) and the Weeping Adit arrival beyond it.

nodes.name: The priory gate
nodes.notes: The gate at the head of the priory road (mw-e26.5 'priory road gate'; PROPOSAL, the bible names only the road and the nave). Where the road from the forest, the ridge path from Mooring's Watch and the road from town all arrive (docs/design/dungeon.md). Built as the precinct gate wall of the bellwater-priory scene (mw-e26.5); the way in from the Briarwood is its road gate (mw-e25.25).

nodes.name: The priory nave
nodes.notes: Roofless nave of Bellwater Priory (bible 3.5, mw-e26.5). Built (mw-e26.5): six metre walls and a colonnade open to the sky; the hub of the priory.

nodes.name: The priory choir
nodes.notes: Singing-monk statues, the Watchers puzzle (bible 3.5, mw-e26.6). Built (mw-e26.5): the choir with four statue stubs and the altar; the puzzle is mw-e26.6.

nodes.name: The priory garden
nodes.notes: Garden with the dead pear tree Clatter remembers (bible 4.1 beat 8; mw-e26.5). Optional dead end off the nave. Built (mw-e26.5): walled garden with the dead pear tree, one opening on the nave.

nodes.name: The scriptorium
nodes.notes: Book mimics (bible 3.5, mw-e26.7). Built (mw-e26.5) as a shelved room behind the locked hidden choir door; its content is mw-e26.7.

nodes.name: The belfry
nodes.notes: The cracked Vesper Bell (bible 3.5, mw-e26.8). Built (mw-e26.5): a 9 m tower with an interior stair, a free-climb and rope anchors; the Sounding Shaft top is its deck; the bell and the sour-bell consequence are mw-e26.8.

nodes.name: The crypt stair
nodes.notes: The stair down from the nave to the sealed crypt door; the Sunbeam puzzle's place (mw-e26.1, docs/design/dungeon.md). PROPOSAL: the bible gives the crypt but no stair. Built (mw-e26.5): a 3 m stair down east of the nave to a landing; the Sunbeam puzzle is mw-e26.15.

nodes.name: The priory crypt
nodes.notes: Sealed from below (bible 4.1 beat 9). Built (mw-e26.5) as a sealed vestibule behind a tier-3 locked door: no walking route from the priory side until world.priory-crypt.unsealed (mw-e26.20).

nodes.name: The cistern
nodes.notes: Old cistern under the Glen Well, joining the priory (bible 3.1, 3.5). Built (mw-e26.5) as the stub the Glen Well route joins: a sealed vestibule behind the nave west wall door; glen-well-cistern (mw-e24.10) and nave-cistern (mw-e26.20) open it.

nodes.name: The Outer Ring
nodes.notes: Hornfolk runes, loom spiders (bible 3.5, mw-e26.9).

nodes.name: The Ossuary Galleries
nodes.notes: The Forgotten; Clatter (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The Chapel of Echoes
nodes.notes: Where sound misbehaves; portcullis trap (bible 3.5, mw-e26.14).

nodes.name: Horn's Hall
nodes.notes: The Warden's hall outside the Fold (bible 3.5, 4.2).

nodes.name: The Fold
nodes.notes: Sealed sleepers' vault; wake-up point (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The Sounding Shaft's foot
nodes.notes: Foot of the shaft to the belfry (bible 3.5, mw-e26.18).

nodes.name: The Cradle
nodes.notes: Heart of the Knot (bible 3.5, 4.1 beat 12).

nodes.name: Briar Glen Quay
nodes.notes: Barge landing and slipway (bible 3.5, mw-e25.11).

nodes.name: The Millweir
nodes.notes: Weir below town with its sluice walk (bible 3.1, mw-e25.12).

nodes.name: The Weeping Adit (river mouth)
nodes.notes: Where the Wend springs from the hill, a flooded drainage tunnel (bible 3.1, mw-e25.13).

nodes.name: Kestrel Lock
nodes.notes: Lock on the towpath and barge route (bible 3.1, mw-e25.14).

nodes.name: The lock-keeper's cottage
nodes.notes: Across the lock gates (bible 3.5).

nodes.name: The Stone Wharf
nodes.notes: Barge landing and hub of the harbour (bible 3.6, mw-e40.2).

nodes.name: The Tidemarket
nodes.notes: Covered import market (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Customs House
nodes.notes: Columned hall; Inspector Cray (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Bonded Warehouse
nodes.notes: Vaulted export bays; bay nine (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Drowned Gull
nodes.notes: Tavern on the breakwater end (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Undertow
nodes.notes: Black market beneath the fish market (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Net Lofts and rooftops
nodes.notes: Continuous waterfront roof route (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Gilded Tern
nodes.notes: Three-masted merchantman in the pool (bible 3.6).

nodes.name: The Breakwater
nodes.notes: Wall of rejected blocks; sunken figurehead (bible 3.6).

Schoolhouse door.
Lychgate cemetery.
The well on the green.
Ledge climb from the lane to the rooftops (every class has verb.climb.ledge).

Forest path from the town side to the hub. Walkable inside the briarwood scene (mw-e25.1); an edge inside one scene has no transition volume.
The Sleepers' Path leaves the forest paths.
Trampled ferns lead to the mine gate; visible at night or to a tracker. CANON GAP: bible does not say where the path ends.
The menhir clearing.
Wolf den.
The hut. Walkable inside the briarwood scene (mw-e25.1); an edge inside one scene has no transition volume.
Millpond and drowned lane.
Forest to priory road (loop edge).

Ridge path from the watch to the priory road (loop edge).
Forest path to the far bank of the Wend.
Up the tower stairs to the roof.
Down into the supply tunnel.
The collapse: a knight shoulder-barges the rotten shoring, a sorcerer burns it away; the long way in for anyone via the gate.

Down to the lower galleries.

The breach, sealable.

Upriver bank to the adit mouth.
Up the flooded Weeping Adit: swim, raft, Frostglass the current's edge, or ride an empty barge winched back up (bible 4.1 beat 5). Open to any class.
The Stone Stair: from the cutting hall down to the quay, one-way until lowered from above.
Towpath downriver to the weir (always open).
The sluice walk across the weir: an archer ropes the rail, a sorcerer lifts the sluice with Mage Hand.
Towpath on to Kestrel Lock (always open).
Towpath on to Wendmouth (always open; bible 3.6).
Mags Oakum's barge, mornings only (bible 3.6).
The barge arrives at the Stone Wharf (bible 3.6).
Across the lock gates once both paddles are up (signal graph kestrel-lock-gates).

Up the priory road to the gate (PROPOSAL, mw-e26.1: the bible has the road and the nave but no gate between them). Built as a gap in the Briarwood's north wall (priory-road-gate) opening on the priory's south edge (road-gate), both ways (mw-e25.25, mw-e26.5). The road itself is the Briarwood's last stretch; if it grows its own scene the transition moves with it.
Through the gate into the roofless nave.

Stairs up to the belfry.
Down the crypt stair, where the Sunbeam puzzle lights the way.
The crypt door, sealed on this side (bible 4.1 beat 9) until the Knot-side seal is broken (mw-e26.5 AC-2): the same fact that opens ossuary-crypt.
Priory end of the cistern (E26).
The loose ladder-rung under the Glen Well; any class can climb down.
The cell drain leads out to the cistern: a thief picks the grate padlock, a knight shoulder-barges the rotten grate.
Through the breach into the Knot.
Outer Ring to the Ossuary.
Ossuary to the Chapel of Echoes.
Chapel to Horn's Hall.
The Fold, past the Warden.
Horn's Hall to the Cradle.
Cradle to the shaft's foot.
The climb to the belfry (bible 4.1 beat 13).
The crypt is sealed from the Knot side; opens once the seal is broken (bible 4.1 beat 9).
Stone Wharf to tidemarket.
Stone Wharf to customs-house.
Stone Wharf to bonded-warehouse.
Stone Wharf to drowned-gull.
Stone Wharf to net-lofts.
Stone Wharf to breakwater.
Stone Wharf to gilded-tern.
Smugglers' tunnel to the harbour wall.
Trapdoor from the Drowned Gull to the Undertow (bible 3.6).
Rooftop route from the net lofts onto the Customs House roof; thieves only.
